create_air_logistics.ponder.airship_mast: Airship Assembly: Blocks, Roles & Super Glue
Sky Dock: Compresses air using the rotational power of the shaft connected to its side and stores it in its internal tank.
The Brass Funnel next to it inserts or extracts cargo from the dock. When a ship docks, cargo is transferred automatically.
Ship Port is the ship's docking hatch. Place it facing the Sky Dock with EXACTLY a 1-BLOCK gap in between. Pressurized air and cargo cross this gap.
Airship Cargo Hold: All transported cargo is stored here.
Campfires: Heat the balloons above. Heated balloons generate lift; unheated balloons cannot lift the ship.
Pressure Tank: +900 Air extra storage to extend range for longer routes.
Place the Pathfinder Propeller on the outer edge with a clear 3x3 space in front. Mount a Pressure Engine (450 Air) directly behind it, and right-click the propeller with a Flight Chart.
The 4 corner fence posts support the 2-layer Canvas Balloon dome directly above the campfires.

MOST IMPORTANT STEP: Every single block of the ship (Wooden Deck, Fence Posts, Balloon Dome, Ship Port, Cargo Hold, Campfires, Pressure Tank, Engine, and Propeller) MUST be glued together with Super Glue! Any unglued block will stay behind at the dock.
Tanks full, Super Glue complete: Lift-off!
create_air_logistics.ponder.pressure_and: Pressurized Air: Dock Power, Gauges & Thrusters
Right-click any face of the Sky Dock except its front face with a Wrench to open a shaft socket on that face.
RPM from the shaft fills the dock's 1800 Air tank. Higher RPM means faster pressurization.
While docked, compressed air automatically flows across the 1-block gap into the Ship Port, filling the ship's engine and tanks.
Pressure Engine: 450 Air internal storage. Its pressure gauge needle shows the live fill level. The ship will not depart without enough air for the route.
Pressure Tank: +900 Air. Provides extra air capacity for long routes. Multiple tanks can be glued to the ship.
Ships exceeding 360 Weight fly slower. Add Boost Propellers—facing the same direction as the Pathfinder Propeller, each with a Pressure Engine behind it—to restore speed.
create_air_logistics.ponder.flight_chart: Right-click a Sky Dock while holding a Flight Chart to register it as a stop on the route, then link the destination dock the same way.
Waypoints: Right-click any ground block, or right-click the air to open the Chart menu and add X/Y/Z coordinates.
Items entering the Brass Funnel pass into the dock and across the Ship Port into the Airship Cargo Hold. Choose LOAD / UNLOAD mode in the dock menu.
Right-click the Pathfinder Propeller with the completed Flight Chart to install it. The ship now follows the route autonomously.
Once air pressure and departure conditions are met, the airship departs automatically, unloads at the destination, and returns.
create_air_logistics.ponder.balloon_phys: WEIGHT: Balloons & Heaters = 0 | Wood, Wool, Glass = 1 | Copper, Casings, Engines & Machines = 2 | Iron, Gold, Obsidian = 3 | Cargo Hold = 30.
Campfire (Lit): +4 Lift per balloon (max 16 balloons per heater). Ideal for light entry-level airships.
Airship Super Heater: +6 Lift per balloon (max 32 balloons per heater) — requires no fuel and powers heavy cargo haulers!
Balloons must form a dome above the heaters. Unheated balloons produce 0 Lift; total Lift must exceed the ship's weight.
create_air_logistics.ponder.fluid_transp: Fluid Transport: Pipes, Fluid Tanks & Automatic Pumping
The Sky Dock transfers fluids as well as items: connect mechanical pipes and a pump to any face to fill its 16,000 mB internal fluid buffer.
Create Fluid Tanks placed on an airship automatically act as onboard fluid storage (10 Weight per block). Multi-block tanks are supported too — be sure to Super Glue every tank block.
When docked, fluids transfer directly across the 1-block gap into the ship's Fluid Tanks. Items and fluids load simultaneously at high speed (4,000 mB every 4 ticks).
Select LOAD or UNLOAD mode in the Sky Dock menu. Departure conditions cover fluids too: in 'Wait Until Full' mode, the ship waits until both cargo holds and fluid tanks are full.
Set the destination dock to UNLOAD with an outgoing pump: fluids automatically drain on arrival. Tanks full, route set — liftoff!
